correctness.rationale: For critical binary Kesten tree, side-branch leaf-count PGFs obey f0(z)=(1+z)/2, f_h(z)=(z+f_{h-1}(z)^2)/2. The zero coefficients a_h=2^{-(2^{h+1}-1)} give the exact probability via coefficients ≤m of product f0...f_(r-1). The support set S*= {r-m,...,r-1} has uniquely maximal removed zero-leaf cost and contributes B_{r,m}=2^{-2^{r-m+1}+r-2m+2}; every other support loses ≥2^{r-m} in the binary exponent. With at most (m+1)r^m supports and b_h≤1/2+a_(h-1), this yields the explicit relative upper bound and the comb-like conditional concentration. m0 equality agrees with prior. The finite tree claim only takes N→infinity at fixed r,m, then r→infinity. Independent exact rational PGF bounds passed for r≤10,m≤3; general proof is symbolic.
